solwarly.book.grinder.1: Right-click the mill with ingredients to insert whole batches. Two-ingredient recipes need both materials. Each batch takes three seconds.
solwarly.book.grinder.2: The two input slots hold different items. Right-click with an empty hand to take both back. If the first slot is empty, the second sends its items out after three seconds.
solwarly.book.grinder.3: Some ingredients have both solo and paired recipes. An unbound mill turns for five seconds to wait for a partner before grinding solo. Redstone forces a single input and sends the second slot out.
solwarly.book.grinder.4: Sneak-right-click with a spice to bind its recipes, or with an empty hand to unbind. A bound mill shows rotating previews of the result and ingredients above it.
solwarly.book.grinder.5: Hoppers above or beside the mill insert ingredients. The bottom extracts products; the sides extract ingredients. Sent-out items and empty containers go to a hopper or configured pipe below first, and drop only if they cannot fit.
